description:
Remaining after the 0.4.2 MuPDF sweep (bd-x0b / gh-111), docs/mupdf-port-coverage.md 'What remains' #3-4: (1) named predefined CMaps (pdf-cmap-load.c cmaps/*.h) -- non-Identity CJK encodings misparse; (2) Adobe *-UCS2 collection maps for CJK fonts without ToUnicode; (3) /W2 /DW2 vertical metrics + stext wmode; (4) bidi (bidi.c) for RTL extraction order; (5) Noto CJK/script fallback faces (noto.c) for non-embedded fonts. None occur in the open harness corpus -- a synthetic/openly licensed CJK fixture is needed first.

Mirrors GitHub gh-113 (https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/kopitiam/issues/113).
title: kopitiam-pdf: CJK -- named CMaps, UCS2 collections, vertical writing, bidi, Noto fallback
